question: Can a fresh root-active fixed-flux Reference panel support the preregistered three-level space-time numerical uncertainty authority before any reduced dynamic root-feedback response is generated?

technical_repair.initial_failure: Public reference-floor wrapper rejected root_extraction_active before Reference Richards execution.
technical_repair.repair: Workflow-local admission repair removed only that wrapper-level root-active rejection on the frozen checkout.

decisive_reference_evidence.interpretation: Both frozen materials independently reach a total-residual-only retry boundary. Local balance and head convergence flags are zero, but the total residual violates the frozen fail-closed numerical contract.

decision.reason: The preregistered C6R pass rule requires a qualified root-active Reference before any reduced response. The frozen root-active failed-first-attempt policy is FAIL_CLOSED_NO_DYN0A_FALLBACK. Relaxing the total-residual gate or enabling a fallback after observing the response is not authorized.

bounded_conclusion: C6R does not provide scientific evidence for or against the minimal Layer-ROM root-feedback approximation. It establishes that the selected high-resolution root-active Reference construction is not numerically qualified under its frozen fail-closed total-residual contract.
not_claimed: No conclusion that layer-mean-head Feddes feedback is sufficient or insufficient.

restart_boundary.required: Independent Reference/numerical-policy authority outside C6R before any restart.
forbidden_within_c6r: Relaxing total residual tolerance after response.
Enabling the legacy DYN0A fallback for root-active cases.
Changing V01-V04, materials, root profiles, demand, spatial or temporal ladder, convergence metrics or qualification formula.
Generating reduced candidate responses while the Reference remains unqualified.
